full_judgment: 2. Facts, relevant for disposal of the Rule are that the plaintiff-opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff filed the above suit for declaration of title in the suit land along with a prayer for a declaration that SA Khatian No. 6 and BRS Khatian No. 6 of the suit land are wrong. Subsequently plaint was amended and prayer for partition was added. The specific case of the plaintiff, is that the suit land appertaining to PS Khatian 5 of an area of 1.56 acres of Mouza Kashta Shagar, PS Palong, District formerly Faridpur now Shariatpur belonged to Ismail Howlader who also belonged 44 decimals of lands of PS Khatian No. 17 of the same Mouza Kashtoshagor and 42 decimals of land of plot No. 49 of PS Khatian No. 3 of the same Mouza and by these way total 2.42 decimals of lands were belonged and possessed by Ismail Howlader who died leaving behind his legal heirs; wife Rahila Begum who got 30 (thirty) decimals of land, one son Nawab Ali got 1.41 acres and one daughter Bona Bibi got 71 decimals of land. Rahila Begum died leaving behind her one son Nawab Ali and one daughter Bona Bibi wherein amongst. 30 decimals of land, her son Nawab Ali inherited 20 decimals of land and daughter Bona Bibi got 10 decimals of land, and in this way, Nawab Ali's father of the plaintiff Lal Mati Bibi got 1.41 acres + 20 acres = 1.61 acres, daughter Bona Bibi got 71 decimals + 10 decimals = 81 decimals; Nawab Ali died leaving his only daughter plaintiff Lal Mati Bibi who acquired 1.61 acres of land as inheritance from her father Nawab Ali; Bona Bibi died leaving her one son Munshi Aynal Hossain and Ainuuddin Munshi defendant No. 1 who inherited 27 decimals, 4 (four) daughter (1) Shaju Bibi wife of late Abdul Wahab Madbar defendant No. 2 who inherited 13'4, decimals of lands, (2) Shonai Bibi wife of late Wazed Sardar defendant No. 3, who inherited 131/2 decimals of land, (3) Kuni Bibi wife of late Ead Ali Munshi defendant No.4 who inherited 13'/2 decimals of land; and (4) Kuti Bibi wife of Wazed Ali Howlader defendant No. 5 who inherited 131/2decimals = 81 decimals of land. That of 15th March 2008 defendant No. 1 Munshi Aynal Hossain disclosed that SA and BS records are prepared in his name and showed fear. That SA records were prepared partly in the name of her predecessor Nawab All but subsequently wrongly prepared in the name of the defendant No. 1. That the BRS record also wrongly prepared in the Khatian No. 6 in the name of the defendant No. 1 and hence the suit.
